name: Kodak ColorPlus 200
notes: H&D approx from memory of the Kodak ColorPlus 200 (Kodacolor-era emulsion) datasheet; straight-line gamma ~0.56-0.58, softer contrast than Gold 200 with a gentle shoulder and a slightly lazy blue layer - the vintage warm/yellow ColorPlus cast. ESTIMATED nearly everything numeric: ColorPlus's published technical data is thin (older-generation emulsion), so spectral crosstalk (wide old-tech layer overlap), weakest-in-set DIR (its muted separation), rms_granularity 6.5 (grainier than Gold 200's 5.5, consistent with the older grain tech - NOT a datasheet RMS), halation, extra-warm orange mask, and print paper are all reasoned estimates around the Gold 200 file. Grain pitch/shadow_bias engine-derived; grain keys flattened for the engine. Real ColorPlus lab scans exist under /mnt/expansion/Photos/Film Scans (README inventory) - untuned so far, candidate for a scan-tuning pass. 2026-07-11
